document_title: Zecpath AI HR Interview — Flow Design Document

phase_flow.label: Introduction
phase_flow.description: AI delivers a warm greeting, explains the interview format, and asks the candidate to introduce themselves.

phase_flow.label: Core HR Questions
phase_flow.description: AI covers the three core HR evaluation areas that apply to every candidate regardless of role or experience level.

phase_flow.label: Role-Based Evaluation
phase_flow.description: AI asks role-specific and experience-level-specific questions to evaluate alignment with the target position.

phase_flow.label: Closing
phase_flow.description: AI confirms availability, notice period, and commitment, then closes the interview with a warm handoff message.

question_set.question_text: Give me a brief introduction — who you are, your current role, and what you have built.
question_set.follow_up: What is the one thing about yourself you most want us to remember?

question_set.question_text: Walk me through your career so far — the roles, the key projects, and why you made each move.
question_set.follow_up: Which experience has had the biggest impact on how you work today?

question_set.question_text: What technical strength sets you apart from other engineers at your level, and what is one gap you are closing?
question_set.follow_up: Can you give me a specific example of a time that weakness affected your work and what you did about it?

question_set.question_text: Tell me about a time you disagreed with a technical decision in your team. How did you handle it?
question_set.follow_up: What kind of team environment brings out the best in you?

question_set.question_text: What does your ideal next step look like technically, and where do you want to be in 5 years?
question_set.follow_up: How does this role specifically fit into those goals?

question_set.question_text: What is your current notice period, and is there any flexibility on that?
question_set.follow_up: Is there anything on your end that might affect your availability in the first 90 days?

self_introduction.label: Self Introduction
self_introduction.description: Candidate introduces themselves, background, and current situation

career_journey.label: Career Journey
career_journey.description: Candidate walks through their professional history and key milestones

strengths_weaknesses.label: Strengths & Weaknesses
strengths_weaknesses.description: Candidate reflects on personal and professional attributes

teamwork_culture_fit.label: Teamwork & Culture Fit
teamwork_culture_fit.description: Candidate demonstrates how they work with others and align with company values

career_goals.label: Career Goals
career_goals.description: Candidate describes short-term and long-term professional aspirations

availability_commitment.label: Availability & Commitment
availability_commitment.description: Candidate confirms availability, notice period, and long-term commitment
